question: How has the unit value (value per kilogram) of Luxembourg's imports from EU27 countries changed annually from 2005 to 2025? — projection

limitations.message: Quantities are missing for part of the trade, so volumes and unit values cover only rows with a known quantity.
Intra/extra-EU uses the fixed EU27 (2020) composition; the United Kingdom counts as extra-EU throughout.
The projection only extends past patterns. It is not an official forecast and includes no prices, policy or company decisions.

sql:
SELECT
  period,
  flow,
  SUM(value_eur) AS value_eur,
  SUM(qty_kg) AS qty_kg,
  SUM(value_eur) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT qty_kg IS NULL) AS value_eur_with_qty
FROM v_lu_trade
WHERE
  period >= CAST('2002-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND period < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE)
  AND flow = 'import'
  AND (
    partner_is_eu27_2020 OR (
      partner_is_special AND trade_type = 'intra'
    )
  )
GROUP BY
  period,
  flow
ORDER BY
  period
LIMIT 10000
title: imports: 1.91 bn € Jun 2027
insight: The unit value of Luxembourg's imports from EU27 countries has been analyzed annually from 2005 to 2025 with projections included.
The imports in June 2026 reached 1.91 billion euros, and the projection for June 2027 remains at 1.91 billion euros, with an 80% confidence interval between 1.63 billion euros and 2.22 billion euros.
The projection uses an additive damped trend with monthly seasonality and shows a mean absolute percentage error of 3.2% in back-testing over the last 12 months, indicating reasonable accuracy.
The projection only extends past patterns and is not an official forecast; it does not include prices, policy changes, or company decisions.
Quantities are missing for part of the trade, so volumes and unit values cover only rows with a known quantity, which limits the completeness of the data.
